title: One Minute Late
style: rock, alternative rock, Canadian rock, male vocals, mid-tempo, acoustic guitars, atmospheric electric guitar riffs, roots rock, clean, acoustic, electric, light, alternative rock, male vocals, bassline, emotional
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
On the steel-cold tracks back in 2009
You were one minute late running out of time
But the fight back to life is a heavy winding road
From the dark of the tracks to the light you showed
Now you're trippin' no more
It's the wellness you seek
With the strength in your chest and the truth that you speak

[Chorus]
Oh
Greg Greg Bond let the music run free
Hear the ghost of the Hip singing down from the tree
Put your voice in the wax let the record expand
Sign your name on the dotted line with Songpal's hand
Yeah
Songpal Records is the sovereign lane
No middleman loops just a clean true domain

[Verse 2]
From the cold Ontario wind to the Masaya heat
San Juan Del Sur where the two currents meet
David Faya is tracking the symphonic bass line
On the VDS master where the signals align
Your memoir is open the pages are spun
Write the next chapter the fight has been won

[Chorus]
Oh
Greg Greg Bond let the music run free
Hear the ghost of the Hip singing down from the tree
Put your voice in the wax let the record expand
Sign your name on the dotted line with Songpal's hand
Yeah
Songpal Records is the sovereign lane
No middleman loops just a clean true domain

[Outro]
Yeah
One minute late but you're right on time
Sign it
Bondzee
Songpal is the line
[fade out with guitar feedback]
